why: THE `fleets:` BLOCK OF kontra.yaml (PRD §7, ADR 0066): a map of named fleet profiles, each one the inputs of one provider's Pulumi program, read by TWO sides with no shared code — the orchestrator's infra role (control/orchestrator/src/infra/fleets.ts), which converges a profile, and the CLI (cli/internal/config/fleets.go), which names and lists them. A drift has the failure shape every config drift has here: one side accepts a file the other refuses, and the refusal arrives at converge time inside an activity instead of at `kontra fleet up`.
rules: `local` IS THE DEFAULT AND NEEDS NOTHING: a file with no `fleets:` key, or none at all, has exactly one profile, `local`, with every default filled in.
`default:` names a profile; it is not a profile. Absent, it is `local` when `local` exists, and otherwise refused — a fleet nobody chose is not chosen silently.
A profile name is the DNS-label subset ^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])?$ because it becomes part of a Pulumi stack name and a Kubernetes label.
STRICT: a key a provider does not know is refused, naming it. A typo in `idle_minutes` would otherwise leave a fleet running all night.
Defaults are filled in by the parser so both sides agree on what an omitted field MEANS: nodes 1, size {cpus 2, memory 4Gi}, idle_minutes 15.
SECRETS ARE NAMED, NOT SHOWN. `public` is what an API response, a log line or the CLI may print: every secret field is replaced by the list of secret fields that are set.

valid.why: no fleets key at all: one local profile, all defaults
the PRD's own example, dummy secrets included
valid.yaml:
fleets:
  default: local
  local:
    provider: local
    nodes: 1
    size: { cpus: 2, memory: 4Gi }
    idle_minutes: 15
  do-fra:
    provider: digital_ocean
    region: fra1
    token: dop_v1_EXAMPLE_not_a_real_token
    ssh_key_fingerprint: "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99"
    vpc_cidr: 10.200.0.0/20
    sizes: { s: s-2vcpu-4gb, m: s-4vcpu-8gb, l: s-8vcpu-16gb }
    idle_minutes: 15
  customer-eks:
    provider: byo_kubeconfig
    kubeconfig: |
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Config

valid.why: a local profile that says only `nodes: 3` (the --nodes 3 fleet tests) keeps every other default
a default that is not `local`, and no local profile at all: an install that only ever runs in the cloud
valid.yaml:
fleets:
  default: do-fra
  do-fra:
    provider: digital_ocean
    region: fra1
    token: dop_v1_x
    ssh_key_fingerprint: "aa:bb"
    sizes: { m: s-4vcpu-8gb }

invalid.why: default names a profile that does not exist
no local profile and no default: nothing was chosen
invalid.yaml:
fleets:
  do-fra:
    provider: digital_ocean
    region: fra1
    token: t
    ssh_key_fingerprint: f
    sizes: { m: s-1vcpu-1gb }

invalid.why: a provider nobody wrote a program for
a typo in a known key is refused rather than ignored
zero nodes is not a fleet
memory must be a Kubernetes quantity in Mi or Gi
invalid.yaml:
fleets:
  local:
    provider: local
    size: { cpus: 2, memory: 4GB }

invalid.why: a cloud profile without its token cannot converge
invalid.yaml:
fleets:
  default: d
  d:
    provider: digital_ocean
    region: fra1
    ssh_key_fingerprint: f
    sizes: { m: s-1vcpu-1gb }

invalid.why: a cloud profile with no sizes has nothing to make nodes from
invalid.yaml:
fleets:
  default: d
  d:
    provider: digital_ocean
    region: fra1
    token: t
    ssh_key_fingerprint: f

fleets:
  default: b
  b:
    provider: byo_kubeconfig

invalid.why: a profile name that cannot be a stack name or a label
invalid.yaml:
fleets:
  default: Do_Fra
  Do_Fra:
    provider: local

invalid.why: a profile that is not a map
fleets that is not a map
